item.description: ### What's new - Ported latest commits from the source repository. - Add PDF viewing with password support, CSV/TSV previews, and diff highlighting. - Add sidebar hover effects and font sizing, preserving Spanish localization. If you already have Silica, it will offer this update on its own, or choose **Silica › Check for Updates…**. Found a bug or have an idea? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/perez987/Silica/issues).

### What's new
- Localize the interface and alerts. - Option to switch windows style (glass / opaque). - Welcome window is optional at launch. - Migrate the Xcode project type to `pbxproj` format
If you already have Silica, it will offer this update on its own, or choose **Silica › Check for Updates…**.
Found a bug or have an idea? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/perez987/Silica/issues).
